notes:
Research notes (as of Oct 12, 2026). The question doesn't say which "football" is meant, soccer or American football, and no place was given. I've covered both. "GOAT" is an opinion, so there is no single factual answer.

**Soccer**
- Most recent coverage leans toward Lionel Messi as the GOAT. A Yahoo Sports/Sporting News piece said it's widely held that Messi is the greatest player in the history of the game.
- The Korea Times (July 13, 2026) said Messi's performances in Qatar and at the 2026 World Cup have strengthened the view that he has edged ahead in the GOAT debate.
- Messi's 2026 World Cup: Argentina reached the final and lost, per the Yahoo Sports headline. Striker Report (Sept 13, 2026) says he ultimately finished the competition with 21 World Cup goals. The same piece says he retired from international football in August 2026 and finished with 125 goals in 207 appearances for Argentina.
- Trophy counts: Messi has eight Ballons d'Or, compared to Ronaldo's five. One fan site (ronaldo-or-messi.com) says Cristiano Ronaldo leads on career goals and Champions League titles (5 to Messi's 4). Its goal totals are approximate and differ from other sources.
- Cristiano Ronaldo: the Korea Times says he became the first player to score in six different World Cups.
- Pelé is still named by some. A TotalFootball/Medium piece argues Pelé remains the greatest footballer of all time, citing his three World Cups. Striker Report also calls Pelé's three World Cup medals the strongest single argument for ranking him first.
- Other voices: Roberto Baggio picked Messi over Pelé and Maradona, while Marco Materazzi backed Ronaldo (Yahoo Sports, July 14, 2026). Ronaldo Nazário also named Messi.

**American football (NFL)**
- Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT. He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time), and Mahomes is 3-2 in Super Bowls.
- Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger. PFSN (Sept 28, 2026) says he matched Brady's 115-35 record through their first 150 career starts. Fans remain divided.
- Mahomes himself has said Brady is the greatest of all time. That quote is from an SI article dated after Super Bowl LVIII (2024), so it is older.

I found no single authoritative ranking in either sport.
